character_facts: The older armored man is the younger character's father.
The father is severely ill, coughing repeatedly and appearing near death.
The father claims responsibility for defeating the Cetacyborg.
The father says he has only a few days left to live.
The younger silver-haired character is emotionally attached to the father and challenges his claim of helplessness.
characters_present: An older white-haired armored man, apparently the younger character's father
A younger silver-haired person dressed in dark clothing
A small robot or machine with a screen-like face
continuity_links: This page follows an earlier conflict with the Cetacyborg, whose aftermath is explained here.
The father's ten-year hiding plan sets up a prolonged period of concealment on the current planet.
The mention of the Shabda-Oud witches connects this scene to prior or future lore about that world or group.
dialogue_meaning: The older man describes a delayed surveillance or communication plan already set in motion across the universe.
He orders the younger person into long-term concealment on the current planet.
He frames the planet as similar to one linked to the Shabda-Oud witches.
The younger person resists the instruction emotionally and asks about the father's fate.
The older man reveals that his victory over the Cetacyborg required self-sacrificial infection tactics.
He announces that he is dying from contamination caused by the defeated monster.
The younger person refuses to accept the explanation at face value and suspects some hidden motive or test.
locations: Interior of a spacecraft or metallic base
A machinery or armory/storage compartment within that interior
lore_facts: Signals from the older man's dispatched 'spy-needles' will not return for ten years.
The planet they are on is said to be like the Shabda-Oud witches' planet.
A being or enemy called the Cetacyborg exists and was defeated from within.
The Cetacyborg used toxic gases capable of contaminating blood and corroding lungs.
plot_events: The older man says he has sent devices or agents across the universe and expects a ten-year delay before any signals return.
He instructs the younger person to remain hidden on this planet for those ten years and says the world resembles a place associated with the Shabda-Oud witches.
The younger person asks why they must stay alone and what will happen to him.
The older man leads or speaks from within a compartment filled with equipment and explains that he defeated the Cetacyborg from within by using virus-like tactics.
He reveals that the same method is now killing him.
He states that his blood is contaminated by the monster's gases and that he has only a few days left to live.
The younger person protests, calling him the most powerful of warriors and asking what game he is playing.
uncertainties: The exact appearance and function of the 'spy-needles' are not shown clearly on this page.
The younger silver-haired character's identity is not named on the page.
Some dialogue terms, especially proper nouns, may be slightly uncertain due to small lettering and scan quality.
visual_summary: An older, visibly ill armored man speaks privately with a younger silver-haired person inside a metallic spacecraft or chamber crowded with machinery and weapons. In close-ups he coughs and grimaces while explaining a long-term plan and his imminent death. The younger figure first listens in silence, then follows him into a storage-like area and reacts in shock and protest.
